Hey, I'm Ayesha.

I'm a design-driven, detail-oriented software engineer focused on combining elegant code and intuitive design, with hands-on experience in training AI models.

I'm a software engineer and UI/UX designer passionate about building user-focused digital experiences. I have experience in web and mobile development using technologies like Next.js, Typescript and React Native, along with designing intuitive interfaces in Figma.

Over the past few months, I have been building my foundation in Artificial Intelligence alongside my development work. I completed a course in Artificial Intelligence, where I gained experience in training basic models and working with data. I developed a strong understanding of AI and algorithms, including regression, decision trees, and deep learning techniques, along with working knowledge of neural networks, CNN, RNN, LSTM, and computer vision. I also explored signal and image processing techniques, where data is preprocessed and prepared for effective model training.

Currently, I am working as a Junior AI Developer intern, applying these concepts to real-world problems. I am gaining hands-on experience in implementing and training machine learning models for prediction tasks, as well as working with APIs and testing tools, while continuing to grow in applied AI and machine learning.
